name: TetWeave
definition: A differentiable isosurface representation that jointly optimizes the placement of an unstructured tetrahedral grid (generated via Delaunay triangulation of an arbitrary point cloud) and a directional signed distance function at each node, used for isosurface extraction with Marching Tetrahedra.
summary: TetWeave is a differentiable isosurface extraction method that reconstructs watertight meshes from point clouds by generating unstructured tetrahedral grids on-the-fly via Delaunay triangulation.
